title: feedback.producers names every component with forward slashes on Windows
intention: feedback.producers returns each component address spelled with forward slashes on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: test_feedback reads 33/34 on Windows, the red being 'a module that CALLS one is' with got ['cairn\\tools\\widget']; after the one-line change it reads 34/34 and the new proof passes where it failed before
traces_to: Law 3: a spelling is not known portable until measured; Law 4: enforced by a proof on the spelling.
how: In cairn/tools/feedback/feedback.py change str(d.relative_to(root)) in producers to d.relative_to(root).as_posix(). Red-first proof: a fixture root with one finding-constructing component asserts producers == ['cairn/tools/widget'] and no backslash.

clauses.claim: producers over a fixture root with one finding-constructing component returns exactly ['cairn/tools/widget'] on Windows, where it returned the backslash spelling

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: test_feedback reads 33/34 on Windows, the red being 'a module that CALLS one is' with got ['cairn\\tools\\widget']; after the one-line change it reads 34/34 and the new proof passes where it failed before
measured.how: ran test_feedback.py and the new proof bare on akiendell before and after the change
